final_topology.title: Government Cloud Segmentation
final_topology.description: Secure cloud infrastructure for government agency with departmental segmentation and centralized monitoring.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology will include a central hub for management and monitoring, with separate spokes for each department, ensuring secure and isolated environments.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management Zone' with an 'Asset Management System' (n_new1) that tracks assets across various zones, indicating a detailed asset inventory.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes numerous data flow links (e.g., nl1, nl2, etc.) and a 'Monitoring Zone' with a 'Monitoring Server' (n10) that collects logs and metrics from various nodes, indicating documented data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for 'Sensitive Data' (z6) and 'Non-Sensitive Data' (z7), with firewalls (n1) and other security controls in place to segment these zones.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n1) that manages traffic to and from various zones, including servers in the 'Sensitive Data Zone' (z6) and 'Non-Sensitive Data Zone' (z7).

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n13) in the 'Identity Management Zone' (z2), which is connected to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10) and other nodes, indicating that trusted DNS servers are configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Service' (n_new2) in the 'MFA Zone' (z_new2) that integrates with the 'Remote Access Zone Management Service' (n_struct3), indicating that MFA is required for remote access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n15) in the 'Management Hub' (z1) that sends logs to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10), indicating the use of DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n14) and an 'Application Firewall' (n16) in the 'Management Hub' (z1), both of which send logs to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10), indicating the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., 'Management Hub', 'Identity Management Zone', 'Operations Zone', etc.) with appropriate segmentation and security controls, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Tool' (n_new3) in the 'IaC Tools Zone' (z_new3) that configures and manages network infrastructure, indicating secure management practices.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n2) in the 'Identity Management Zone' (z2) that sends logs to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10), indicating centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Service' (n_new4) in the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10) that integrates with the 'Remote Access Zone Management Service' (n_struct3), indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n18) in the 'Management Hub' (z1) that is segmented from other zones and does not have direct internet access, indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central IDS/IPS' (n9) in the 'Management Hub' (z1) that sends logs to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n1) that manages traffic between various zones, including 'Sensitive Data Zone' (z6) and 'Non-Sensitive Data Zone' (z7), indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control System' (n_new5) in the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10) that integrates with the 'Remote Access Zone Management Service' (n_struct3), indicating managed access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central IDS/IPS' (n9) that sends traffic analysis logs to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10), indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central IDS/IPS' (n9) in the 'Management Hub' (z1) that sends logs to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NAC Server' (n17) in the 'Management Hub' (z1) that sends logs to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10), indicating the deployment of port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' (n16) in the 'Management Hub' (z1) that sends logs to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10), indicating the performance of application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z_preserve1) that is separate from other zones, indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Pen Testing Zone' (z11) with a 'Penetration Testing Server' (n19) that sends logs to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10), indicating the performance of periodic external penetration tests.
